title: Plumber return
description: Return shape for a `plumber-<slug>:` dispatch: the user-approved harness repair role (skills/plumber/SKILL.md). Every change it made is listed with how it was verified, so the orchestrator and the user can audit the repair against the plumber log.

approval.description: The user's approval this grant was opened with, verbatim.

diagnosis.description: What was broken, and the evidence for it (hashes, file contents, hook output).

changes.description: Every file written, deleted or regenerated, and every installer run. Empty only when status is no-change-needed or blocked.

verification.description: How the repair was proved: the gate that was blocking now allows, the chain hash matches, the installed hooks diff clean against the package.

ledgerRow.description: The approvedDeviations[] entry added to the ledger, when a ledger was repaired.

followUps.description: Anything the plumber could not or would not fix, for the user.
